definitions.explanation: A naturally raised area of land, smaller than a mountain.

examples.english: There's a house on the hill.

examples.japanese: ⟦なだらかな→なだらか：19406_nadaraka⟧{丘|おか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Gentle hills stretch out into the distance.

examples.japanese: {丘|おか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見下|みお}ろす→見下ろす：04569_miorosu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: When I looked down at the town from the top of the hill, the view was very beautiful.
When spring comes, flowers bloom on this hill and it gets lively with people taking walks.

notes:
{丘|おか} is a hill or hillock, a naturally raised landform smaller than a mountain.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {丘|おか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧: on top of the hill
- {丘|おか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧: to climb a hill
- {丘|おか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧: to go down a hill
- ⟦なだらかな→なだらか：19406_nadaraka⟧{丘|おか}: gentle/rolling hills

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{丘陵|きゅうりょう}→丘陵：20394_kyuuryou⟧: hills, hilly terrain
- ⟦{丘陵地|きゅうりょうち}→丘陵地：noentry⟧: hilly area
- ⟦{砂丘|さきゅう}→砂丘：19972_sakyuu⟧: sand dune

SIZE COMPARISON:
- ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧: mountain (larger)
- {丘|おか}: hill (medium)
- ⟦{台地|だいち}→台地：noentry⟧: plateau, tableland

Note: {丘|おか} often appears in place names, such as ⟦{代々木|よよぎ}→代々木：noentry⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{丘|おか}.
